source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: EmptyTrash accepts an optional URL listener. The failure callback now checks it before forwarding the operation status to OnStopRunningUrl, and returns NS_OK when no notification target exists. That return describes handling the callback, not a successful remote deletion. Remote success still precedes local deletion and its stop notification. The current null-listener test covers success, not forced failure; no crash or callback run was reproduced.
title: Trash failure notification tolerates an absent URL listener
